The '''''Gant Wanar''''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]]. It ferried the [[Venithon Twins]]' [[Starship/Legends|starship]], ''[[Venithon Bandit]]'', to a meeting with [[Safonne Pendon]] aboard the ''[[Safonne's Sword]]''.
